programs.title: CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programs.desc: When a young girl's boyfriend is found dead, the CSIs go after her string of ex-boyfriends and suspicious mother to find the killer.

programs.title: CSI: Miami
programs.desc: An investigation concerning a young murdered woman leads the CSIs to the her apartment, where they discover a meth lab and become well acquainted with an unprincipled man of many secrets who works as an agent for the FBI.

programs.title: CSI: New York
programs.desc: A murderer wages a cyber war on healthcare workers he holds a grudge against. Calling himself Grave Digger, the killer enmeshes Mac in his scheme, claiming there is a bond between them - but the team has an opportunity to foil his plan when he unwittingly reveals the identity of his next target. Crime drama, starring Gary Sinise and Anna Belknap, with Greg Germann (Ally McBeal).

programs.title: NCIS: Hawai'i
programs.desc: While Jane is questioned following Maggie Shaw's arrest, the rest of the team investigates a mysterious case of Marines with damaged ear canals from a weapon that emits ultrasonic waves. Also, Ernie visits his friend, Dr. Tony Lee (Alec Mapa), to identify possible suspects who had access to his classified weapon.

programs.title: NCIS: Hawai'i
programs.desc: As Jesse enjoys a day sailing with his daughter, pirates suddenly seize their yacht, take the passengers hostage and attack Jesse, leaving it up to his team to quickly locate and rescue his daughter.
